description: Technical grounding of intended end state against 10 reality dimensions for each product and shared standard

scopes.grounding_summary: EOS intent is clear (entrepreneur platform, Initiate Arena revenue) but technically ungrounded due to massive source divergence. Two branches exist with 3x file count difference. Beast branch has Clerk and expanded features but has never been CI-validated. Cannot ground the end state until source strategy is decided.
gaps: Source divergence — 401 files of difference between branches
risks: RISK-001: Branch divergence is certain and critical
RISK-002: Blind merge could break everything
scopes.readiness_status: NOT READY — source strategy unresolved, all 13 layers blocked
scopes.implementation_blocked_reason: Source strategy (DEC-145-001) must be resolved. Cannot build on an undecided codebase.
scopes.safe_next_action: Resolve DEC-145-001 (EOS source strategy). Then validate build on chosen branch. Then define readiness gate.

scopes.grounding_summary: CreatorOS has a critical auth bypass vulnerability (comparePasswords returns true). This single issue makes the entire application technically ungrounded for any user-facing deployment. Beyond auth, MVP scope is undefined, god files need splitting, and no production infrastructure exists.
gaps: CRITICAL: Auth bypass — comparePasswords returns true for all passwords
risks: RISK-003: Auth bypass is certain and critical
RISK-004: God files are high risk
scopes.readiness_status: NOT READY — auth bypass is a showstopper, MVP scope undefined
scopes.implementation_blocked_reason: Auth bypass must be fixed before any user-facing work. MVP scope must be decided before feature prioritization.
scopes.safe_next_action: Decide MVP scope (DEC-145-002). Plan auth bypass fix as P0 security work packet. Do not deploy under any circumstances until auth is fixed.

scopes.grounding_summary: LyfeOS is the most technically grounded product. Deployed MVP at lyfeos.net, 35 database tables, GitHub/Beast aligned, functional UI and API. Primary gaps are production hardening: backups, observability, auth standardization to Clerk, and Fly.io migration.
gaps: Legacy auth (Firebase/Passport) — functional but not Clerk
No confirmed backup strategy on deployed MVP
PRD v1 vs v2 scope unclear
risks: RISK-007: Auth migration risk (but lower than CreatorOS)
scopes.readiness_status: CONDITIONALLY READY — deployed MVP works. Production hardening needed for 13-layer compliance.
scopes.implementation_blocked_reason: Phase 14.5A is design-only. LyfeOS hardening work is deferred to execution phase.
scopes.safe_next_action: Verify LyfeOS backups immediately (urgent — deployed app with user data). Decide PRD version (DEC-145-003). Plan production hardening work packets.

scopes.grounding_summary: UMH is the most technically grounded component. Production-deployed orchestrator with functional cockpit, Docker services, governance engine, production truth promotion pipeline. Gaps are hardening: RLS on platform tables, Docker resource limits, recovery documentation, and logging consistency.
gaps: No rate limiting on cockpit API
scopes.readiness_status: OPERATIONAL — 7/13 layers ready, 4 partially operational, 2 gaps
scopes.implementation_blocked_reason: Phase 14.5A is design-only. UMH hardening is deferred.
scopes.safe_next_action: Continue operating. Plan hardening work packets for gaps.

scopes.grounding_summary: OS Platform Standard v2 is technically grounded. It codifies the actual shared technology stack (React/Vite/TypeScript/Express/Drizzle/Neon/Clerk/Fly.io) that all three apps already use. The primary update from v1 is removing stale Firebase auth and adding the 13-layer requirement.
gaps: Firebase auth recommendation in v1 is stale — replaced with Clerk in v2
risks: RISK-009: Stale OS Platform Standard auth
required_operator_decisions: DEC-145-005: OS Platform Standard v2 scope
scopes.readiness_status: READY for ratification as documentation standard. NOT ready for implementation.
scopes.implementation_blocked_reason: Standard is documentation-only in this phase.
scopes.safe_next_action: Ratify v2 standard with operator. Begin using as reference for product design.
